name: std-learn-goal-seek
description: Generic goal-seek (inverse-problem) instrument — a config-declared target curve is drawn from a hidden parameter pair, and the learner tunes their own two parameters with sliders until their curve matches it, then presses Check to be graded against an RMS-distance tolerance. The curve family (power y = A·xᴮ, linear y = A + B·x, or sine y = A·sin(B·x)), the hidden target parameters, the tolerance, and every label are config-declared, so the same mechanism serves any inverse problem: fit a demand curve, match a projectile arc, tune a growth rate, recover a wave's amplitude and frequency. A live distance readout (optionally hidden for a harder variant) plays warmer/colder. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

schema.description: Generic goal-seek (inverse-problem) instrument — a config-declared target curve is drawn from a hidden parameter pair, and the learner tunes their own two parameters with sliders until their curve matches it, then presses Check to be graded against an RMS-distance tolerance. A live distance readout (optionally hidden for a harder variant) plays warmer/colder. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.
schema.name: std-learn-goal-seek

curveKind.description: Curve family both curves are drawn from: power (y = A·xᴮ), linear (y = A + B·x), or sine (y = A·sin(B·x)).
curveKind.label: Curve Kind
curveKind.synonyms: curve family, power law, linear function, sine wave, function type

goalText.default: Tune the two sliders until your curve matches the target curve, then press Check.
goalText.description: One-sentence statement of the inverse problem the learner must solve.
goalText.label: Goal Text

matchMode.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.
matchMode.label: Match Mode

paramADefault.description: Starting value of the learner's first parameter.
paramADefault.label: Parameter A Default

paramALabel.description: Display label for the first parameter.
paramALabel.label: Parameter A Label

paramBDefault.description: Starting value of the learner's second parameter.
paramBDefault.label: Parameter B Default

paramBLabel.description: Display label for the second parameter.
paramBLabel.label: Parameter B Label

showLiveDistance.description: When true the RMS distance updates live as the learner tunes (warmer/colder); when false only attempts are shown, for a harder variant.
showLiveDistance.label: Show Live Distance

targetA.description: Hidden first parameter of the target curve the learner must recover.
targetA.label: Target A

targetB.description: Hidden second parameter of the target curve the learner must recover.
targetB.label: Target B

tolerance.description: Maximum RMS distance between learner and target curves that still counts as a match.
tolerance.label: Tolerance

emits.description: The learner's parameter values and current distance after a slider change — a composed listener (readout, coach) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
The verdict of a Check press: whether the learner's curve is within tolerance of the target, the RMS distance, and how many attempts it took.
emits.synonyms: goal seek, inverse problem, curve fitting, match the target, tune to fit

emits.description: The learner reset the instrument back to the default parameters.
Fired once when a Check lands within tolerance (the goal is matched) — the standard learning completion broadcast a celebration/progression sibling (fx cues, badges) rides.
emits.synonyms: round complete, finished, done, completion, solved

events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.
events.name: Mode Selected

events.description: Learner dragged the first parameter's slider — value is the new A; the learner curve and its distance to the target recompute immediately.
events.name: Set Param A

events.description: Learner dragged the second parameter's slider — value is the new B; the learner curve and its distance to the target recompute immediately.
events.name: Set Param B

events.description: Learner asked to be graded — the current RMS distance is compared against the tolerance and the attempt is counted.
events.name: Check

events.description: Learner reset the parameters to their defaults and cleared the attempt count; the target stays the same.
events.name: Reset

    yMin : number

                  (x (+ @config.xMin (* @i (/ @span 80))))

                          (* @tA (math/pow @x @tB))
                          (if (== @kind "linear")
                            (+ @tA (* @tB @x))
                            (* @tA (math/sin (* @tB @x))))))

                  (x (+ @config.xMin (* @i (/ @span 80))))

                          (* @A (math/pow @x @B))

                            (* @A (math/sin (* @B @x))))))

        (set @entity.solved (if (<= @entity.distance @config.tolerance) true false))
        (set @entity.feedback (if (<= @entity.distance @config.tolerance)
          (str/concat "Matched! Distance " (math/round @entity.distance 3) " is within tolerance " (math/round @config.tolerance 3) ".")
          (str/concat "Not yet — distance " (math/round @entity.distance 3) " is above tolerance " (math/round @config.tolerance 3) ". Keep tuning.")))
        (set @entity.resultRow (array/concat (if @entity.solved [ { type: badge, variant: success, label: "Solved" } ] []) [ { type: typography, variant: caption, content: @entity.feedback } ]))
        (render-ui main {
          type: box
          padding: md
          children: [
            { type: stack, direction: vertical, gap: md, children: [
                { type: typography, variant: h4, content: @entity.title },
                { type: typography, variant: body, content: @config.goalText },
                { type: stack, direction: vertical, gap: xs, children: [
                    { type: typography, variant: caption, content: (str/concat @entity.paramALabel ": " (math/round @entity.paramA 2)) },
                    { type: range-slider, min: @config.paramAMin, max: @config.paramAMax, step: @config.paramAStep, value: @entity.paramA, showTooltip: true, action: "SET_PARAM_A" }
                  ] },
                { type: stack, direction: vertical, gap: xs, children: [
                    { type: typography, variant: caption, content: (str/concat @entity.paramBLabel ": " (math/round @entity.paramB 2)) },
                    { type: range-slider, min: @config.paramBMin, max: @config.paramBMax, step: @config.paramBStep, value: @entity.paramB, showTooltip: true, action: "SET_PARAM_B" }
                  ] },
                { type: math-canvas, width: @config.width, height: @config.height, title: "", xMin: @config.xMin, xMax: @config.xMax, yMin: @entity.yMin, yMax: @entity.yMax, showAxes: @config.showAxes, showGrid: @config.showGrid, gridStep: @config.gridStep, curves: @entity.curves, points: [], vectors: [], shapes: [], interactive: false, animate: false },
                { type: typography, variant: body, content: (if @config.showLiveDistance (str/concat "Distance from target: " (math/round @entity.distance 3) " · attempts: " (str/concat "" @entity.attempts)) (str/concat "Attempts: " (str/concat "" @entity.attempts))) },
                { type: stack, direction: horizontal, gap: sm, children: [
                    { type: button, action: CHECK, label: @config.checkLabel, variant: primary, disabled: (if @entity.solved true false) },
                    { type: button, action: RESET, label: "Reset", variant: ghost }
                  ] },
                { type: stack, direction: horizontal, gap: xs, children: @entity.resultRow }
              ] }
          ]
        })
        (emit GOAL_CHECKED { matched: @entity.solved, distance: @entity.distance, attempts: @entity.attempts })
        (if @entity.solved (emit LEARN_ROUND_COMPLETE { score: 1, total: 1 }) null)

      RESET -> idle when (== @entity.active true)
        (let (
            (A @config.paramADefault)
            (B @config.paramBDefault)
            (kind @entity.curveKind)
            (span (- @config.xMax @config.xMin))
            (samples (array/map (array/range 0 81) (fn (i)
              (let (
                  (x (+ @config.xMin (* @i (/ @span 80))))
                  (yVal (if (== @kind "power")
                          (* @A (math/pow @x @B))
                          (if (== @kind "linear")
                            (+ @A (* @B @x))
                            (* @A (math/sin (* @B @x))))))
                )
                { x: @x, y: @yVal }))))
            (dist (math/sqrt (/ (array/sum (array/map (array/range 0 81) (fn (i)
              (let (
                  (dY (- (object/get (array/nth @samples @i) y) (object/get (array/nth @entity.targetSamples @i) y)))
                )
                (* @dY @dY))))) 81)))
            (allSamples (array/concat @samples @entity.targetSamples))
            (yMinRaw (array/reduce @allSamples (object/get (array/nth @allSamples 0) y) (fn (acc s) (math/min @acc (object/get @s y)))))
            (yMaxRaw (array/reduce @allSamples (object/get (array/nth @allSamples 0) y) (fn (acc s) (math/max @acc (object/get @s y)))))
            (yPad (* 0.1 (math/max 0.001 (- @yMaxRaw @yMinRaw))))
          )
          (do
            (set @entity.paramA @A)
            (set @entity.paramB @B)
            (set @entity.distance @dist)
            (set @entity.attempts 0)
            (set @entity.solved false)
            (set @entity.feedback "")
            (set @entity.yMin (- @yMinRaw @yPad))
            (set @entity.yMax (+ @yMaxRaw @yPad))
            (set @entity.curves [
              { label: @config.targetLabel, color: @config.targetColor, samples: @entity.targetSamples },
              { label: @config.learnerLabel, color: @config.learnerColor, samples: @samples }
            ])))
        (set @entity.resultRow (array/concat (if @entity.solved [ { type: badge, variant: success, label: "Solved" } ] []) [ { type: typography, variant: caption, content: @entity.feedback } ]))
        (render-ui main {
          type: box
          padding: md
          children: [
            { type: stack, direction: vertical, gap: md, children: [
                { type: typography, variant: h4, content: @entity.title },
                { type: typography, variant: body, content: @config.goalText },
                { type: stack, direction: vertical, gap: xs, children: [
                    { type: typography, variant: caption, content: (str/concat @entity.paramALabel ": " (math/round @entity.paramA 2)) },
                    { type: range-slider, min: @config.paramAMin, max: @config.paramAMax, step: @config.paramAStep, value: @entity.paramA, showTooltip: true, action: "SET_PARAM_A" }
                  ] },
                { type: stack, direction: vertical, gap: xs, children: [
                    { type: typography, variant: caption, content: (str/concat @entity.paramBLabel ": " (math/round @entity.paramB 2)) },
                    { type: range-slider, min: @config.paramBMin, max: @config.paramBMax, step: @config.paramBStep, value: @entity.paramB, showTooltip: true, action: "SET_PARAM_B" }
                  ] },
                { type: math-canvas, width: @config.width, height: @config.height, title: "", xMin: @config.xMin, xMax: @config.xMax, yMin: @entity.yMin, yMax: @entity.yMax, showAxes: @config.showAxes, showGrid: @config.showGrid, gridStep: @config.gridStep, curves: @entity.curves, points: [], vectors: [], shapes: [], interactive: false, animate: false },
                { type: typography, variant: body, content: (if @config.showLiveDistance (str/concat "Distance from target: " (math/round @entity.distance 3) " · attempts: " (str/concat "" @entity.attempts)) (str/concat "Attempts: " (str/concat "" @entity.attempts))) },
                { type: stack, direction: horizontal, gap: sm, children: [
                    { type: button, action: CHECK, label: @config.checkLabel, variant: primary, disabled: (if @entity.solved true false) },
                    { type: button, action: RESET, label: "Reset", variant: ghost }
                  ] },
                { type: stack, direction: horizontal, gap: xs, children: @entity.resultRow }
              ] }
          ]
        })
        (emit GOAL_RESET { attempts: 0 })
    }

    listens {
      MODE_SELECTED {
        mode : string
      }
        @description "Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null."
        @tier "domain"
      SET_PARAM_A {
        value : number
      }
        @description "Learner dragged the first parameter's slider — value is the new A; the learner curve and its distance to the target recompute immediately."
        @tier "domain"
      SET_PARAM_B {
        value : number
      }
        @description "Learner dragged the second parameter's slider — value is the new B; the learner curve and its distance to the target recompute immediately."
        @tier "domain"
      CHECK {
      }
        @description "Learner asked to be graded — the current RMS distance is compared against the tolerance and the attempt is counted."
        @tier "domain"
      RESET {
      }
        @description "Learner reset the parameters to their defaults and cleared the attempt count; the target stays the same."
        @tier "domain"
    }

    emits {
      PARAMS_CHANGED -> external {
        paramA : number
        paramB : number
        distance : number
      }
        @description "The learner's parameter values and current distance after a slider change — a composed listener (readout, coach) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone."
        @tier "domain"
      GOAL_CHECKED -> external {
        matched : boolean
        distance : number
        attempts : number
      }
        @description "The verdict of a Check press: whether the learner's curve is within tolerance of the target, the RMS distance, and how many attempts it took."
        @synonyms "goal seek, inverse problem, curve fitting, match the target, tune to fit"
        @tier "domain"
      GOAL_RESET -> external {
        attempts : number
      }
        @description "The learner reset the instrument back to the default parameters."
        @tier "domain"
      LEARN_ROUND_COMPLETE -> external {
        score : number
        total : number
      }
        @description "Fired once when a Check lands within tolerance (the goal is matched) — the standard learning completion broadcast a celebration/progression sibling (fx cues, badges) rides."
        @synonyms "round complete, finished, done, completion, solved"
        @tier "domain"
    }

    config {
      matchMode : string = ""
        @label "Match Mode"
        @description "When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT."
        @tier "presentation"
      title : string = "Goal Seek"
        @label "Title"
        @description "Title shown above the canvas."
        @tier "presentation"
      goalText : string = "Tune the two sliders until your curve matches the target curve, then press Check."
        @label "Goal Text"
        @description "One-sentence statement of the inverse problem the learner must solve."
        @tier "domain"
      curveKind : string = "sine"
        @label "Curve Kind"
        @description "Curve family both curves are drawn from: power (y = A·xᴮ), linear (y = A + B·x), or sine (y = A·sin(B·x))."
        @synonyms "curve family, power law, linear function, sine wave, function type"
        @tier "domain"
      targetA : number = 2.5
        @label "Target A"
        @description "Hidden first parameter of the target curve the learner must recover."
        @tier "domain"
      targetB : number = 1.5
        @label "Target B"
        @description "Hidden second parameter of the target curve the learner must recover."
        @tier "domain"
      tolerance : number = 0.35
        @label "Tolerance"
        @description "Maximum RMS distance between learner and target curves that still counts as a match."
        @tier "domain"
      showLiveDistance : boolean = true
        @label "Show Live Distance"
        @description "When true the RMS distance updates live as the learner tunes (warmer/colder); when false only attempts are shown, for a harder variant."
        @tier "domain"
      paramALabel : string = "A"
        @label "Parameter A Label"
        @description "Display label for the first parameter."
        @tier "presentation"
      paramAMin : number = -5
        @label "Parameter A Min"
        @tier "domain"
      paramAMax : number = 5
        @label "Parameter A Max"
        @tier "domain"
      paramAStep : number = 0.1
        @label "Parameter A Step"
        @tier "presentation"
      paramADefault : number = 1
        @label "Parameter A Default"
        @description "Starting value of the learner's first parameter."
        @tier "domain"
      paramBLabel : string = "B"
        @label "Parameter B Label"
        @description "Display label for the second parameter."
        @tier "presentation"
      paramBMin : number = -5
        @label "Parameter B Min"
        @tier "domain"
      paramBMax : number = 5
        @label "Parameter B Max"
        @tier "domain"
      paramBStep : number = 0.1
        @label "Parameter B Step"
        @tier "presentation"
      paramBDefault : number = 1
        @label "Parameter B Default"
        @description "Starting value of the learner's second parameter."
        @tier "domain"
      targetLabel : string = "Target"
        @label "Target Label"
        @tier "presentation"
      learnerLabel : string = "Yours"
        @label "Learner Label"
        @tier "presentation"
      targetColor : string = "#94a3b8"
        @label "Target Color"
        @tier "presentation"
      learnerColor : string = "#3b82f6"
        @label "Learner Color"
        @tier "presentation"
      checkLabel : string = "Check"
        @label "Check Label"
        @tier "presentation"
      xMin : number = 0
        @label "X Min"
        @tier "presentation"
      xMax : number = 10
        @label "X Max"
        @tier "presentation"
      width : number = 600
        @label "Width"
        @tier "presentation"
      height : number = 400
        @label "Height"
        @tier "presentation"
      showAxes : boolean = true
        @label "Show Axes"
        @tier "presentation"
      showGrid : boolean = true
        @label "Show Grid"
        @tier "presentation"
      gridStep : number = 1
        @label "Grid Step"
        @tier "presentation"
    }
  }

  page "/learn-goal-seek" as GoalSeekPage -> GoalSeekSim
}
